usage.note: These numbers are for the whole server, not only the projects. Each bar splits what is in use between the projects, Portta, and the system and everything else running there.
usage.diskWhole: The whole disk the server runs on. Splitting it by project is not measured yet.

who.title: What is using the server
who.description: Tells the projects apart from the operating system and everything else on the server.

verdict.memory: Projects use {{percent}} of the memory in use.
verdict.cpu: Projects use {{percent}} of the CPU in use.
verdict.disk: Projects use {{percent}} of the disk in use.

who.rest: The other {{percent}} is the system, Portta and other programs.
who.diskNote: The disk is shown as a whole for now. Splitting it by project needs a storage measurement per project, which is not collected yet.
who.list: Projects, largest first · share of the server
who.empty: No project is using this resource right now.
who.unmeasured: The server does not report this resource.

clock.sameAsYou: Same time zone as your browser.
clock.differsFromYou: A different time zone from your browser.
